messages.subject: Looking for a co-mentor for my project
parts:
Dear all, 

I'm looking for a co-mentor for my project (https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2016/wiki/Visualization-of-powerful-boundary-detection-tools). The ideal co-mentor has prior GSoC experience & can provide technical advice to students in terms of programming (say C/C++ and R programing). The current plan is to make this project finally reach out to a large scientific community & I'll be the responsible for the statistical modeling and algorithms. I prefer you that do not have any statistical background, since we need inputs from outsiders (it won't be a serious problem if you do). I already got a pile of applications so welcome in! 

Please kindly let me know. Thanks!

Best,
Meng
